MATCH (s:Statute)-[:CONTAINS_PROVISION]->(p:Provision)
WHERE toLower(s.state) = 'alabama'

WITH s, p,
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'eviction' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'residential' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'eviction' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(s.summary) CONTAINS 'eviction' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(s.summary) CONTAINS 'landlord' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(s.summary) CONTAINS 'tenant' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN EXISTS {
     MATCH (p)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:AreaOfLaw {name: 'Landlord-Tenant and Housing'})
   } THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.type IN ['Procedure or Process', 'General Rule'] THEN 5 ELSE 0 END)
  AS score

WHERE score > 0

WITH s, p, score
ORDER BY score DESC
WITH s, max(score) AS score, head(collect(p)) AS best

WITH s, best, score,
  COLLECT {
    MATCH (best)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:Condition)
    RETURN {number: c.number, description: c.description}
  } AS conditions

RETURN 
  s.idx AS statute_idx, 
  s.citation AS citation, 
  s.summary AS source_summary, 
  best.rule AS provision_rule, 
  conditions, 
  score

ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 20
